acceptance: Every dialect that uses QUALIFY elimination is listed with a test covering ORDER BY, DISTINCT and LIMIT placement
Any dialect that loses ordering or changes row sets is fixed
tpchavoc 1_v8 passes in order on each locally runnable affected engine
description: PR #4154 fixed QUALIFY elimination for presto, trino and athena so ORDER BY stays on the outermost select (tpchavoc 1_v8). Other dialects routed through the same elimination in benchbox/utils/dialect_utils.py likely still drop the outer ORDER BY, and DISTINCT and LIMIT still stay inside the derived table, which changes results when they must apply after the QUALIFY filter.
